## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmations: Energy and Communication leading (1W outperformance) while Financials and Consumer Disc. lag, and leadership concentration is narrow (Top 5 skewed to Tech/Comm). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy lead: XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +7.75%) ABOVE TREND. 
Communication strong: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +2.47% | 1M: -8.57%) RECOVERY. 
Technology showing pockets of strength: PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +20.81% | 1M: -13.14%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag: JPM (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -1.84%) RECOVERY but sector down (1W: -0.52%). 
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND, LOW (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -3.50%) BELOW TREND. 
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +20.81% | 1M: -13.14%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +10.44% | 1M: -3.26%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +10.18% | 1M: -11.80%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Tech/Comm concentration).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: EL (1W: -14.11% | 1M: -14.11%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) BELOW TREND, F (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND, ASML (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -4.24%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-vol Tech and select Consumer names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +20.81% | 1M: -13.14%) RECOVERY, PLTR (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%) ABOVE TREND; note multiple RECOVERY cases (INTU, NOW, PANW) — short-term bounces, not broad confirmations.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with rotation within the group; AAPL (1W: -3.08% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND while select software names run — sector 1W: +1.05% across 24 stocks, watch narrow leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft near-term; JPM (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -1.84%) RECOVERY and V (1W: +4.43% | 1M: -0.11%) RECOVERY show pockets of strength but sector is negative (1W: -0.52% across 20 stocks). Monitor whether bank/credit names can broaden gains.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Stable-to-mixed; UNH (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +9.16%) ABOVE TREND offset losers like LLY (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -2.67%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: +0.05% across 17 stocks.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Energy and select Communication/Software winners (XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND; NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to persistent laggards in Consumer Disc. and cyclical Materials (NKE (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; caution on narrow Tech/Comm leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation, UNH (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND for sector strength, XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND on Energy tailwinds. 
BEARISH: AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) BELOW TREND after heavy sell-off, LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -14.11% | 1M: -14.11%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +13.05%) — breadth support and multiple ABOVE TREND names. 
BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -2.84%) and Materials (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +4.33%) — watch for spillover into Industrials.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) BELOW TREND — watch 1M support area for stabilization. 
AAPL (1W: -3.08% | 1M: +1.74%) CORRECTION — monitor 1W reversal to confirm resume of 1M uptrend. 
NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND — a break below the recent pivot would signal momentum loss. 
XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND — holds as energy risk valve for broader market.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PFE (+65): PFE (1W: -2.06% | 1M: +0.53%) CORRECTION — positive Phase 3 news aligns with a mild 1M gain, sentiment confirming price. 
AMD (+60): AMD (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%) BELOW TREND — CEO growth comments clash with sharp price decline, divergence (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
LRCX (-45): LRCX (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm price weakness. 
CVS (-45): CVS (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +8.01%) ABOVE TREND — regulatory/operational headlines are bearish but price is rising, notable divergence. 
F (-50): F (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND — recall news confirming downside.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. NFLX (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Tech/Comm leadership and headline/price divergences (e.g., AMD, CVS, PFE) — watch for trend confirmation.
